node.title: Re: PDF::API2: Difference between the contents of the outputs of the “to_string” and “save” methods
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: This kind of thing can happen when the files are opened with the wrong encoding (in this case I assume it should be :raw, Update: which actually [doc://PerlIO|means] "no other encoding layers" or "binary") or with :crlf enabled, and you may need to [doc://binmode] the file that you are opening yourself, but that's just a guess. Can you please post a [id://1177642] that reproduces the issue?
